about: What changed on nfs4.xyz, day by day. Kinds: new, improved, fixed. Days run 05:00 to 05:00 Polish time. nfs3-webgl's tools/discord/changelog.mjs posts them to Discord.

items: Watching a replay no longer puts its laps on the Lap Records as yours.
The game download checks free space first, asks before using mobile data, and keeps going when the screen locks.
Online rooms show each player's country flag.
A second tab can take over the game (Play here instead); an open page updates itself to a newer version.
Clearer help in in-app browsers (Instagram and the like) and private windows; after a missing-file crash the game files are checked again.
Faster file loading, steadier sound, and the game is downloaded once per version.
Lap Records: each racer's best lap on every track, online races too, with ▶ replay to watch that race in your game.
Your name is yours, lap records included. 8 words (Use on another device) make you the same racer elsewhere. No account.
Online: invite links wait for nearby relay servers; links that fail log why.
Crackling, robotic sound in the browser.
Running out of memory after long sessions or many races.
Gamepads and wheels: press a button before Start, then pick it in Options › Controllers.
Phones: touch controls (buttons, stick or tilt); iPhone saves on iOS 18, sound with the silent switch on.
Game Settings: fullscreen, FPS counter, intro movies, resolutions, sharpness, volume.
Clear messages when the browser can't run the game; one tab at a time.
Online: dropped players rejoin within 20 s; TURN relays for strict routers; a sturdier server.
Discord server for help, bug reports, ideas and finding races: linked in the menu and in the beta note.
What's New: this list of changes, day by day.
A new look: a lo-fi start page with a new emblem and icons.
An early beta notice, with where to report problems.
Smoother menus: the game's threads take turns by priority, as on Windows 98, and file lookups are much faster.
Smoother online races and steadier frame pacing, from NFS3 Web.
First version: Need for Speed: High Stakes (with VEG's Modern Patch) recompiled to WebAssembly. Bring your own game folder; it never leaves your browser.
Online races in the browser over the game's LAN (IPX) mode.
